evals.name: Private API health is separate from server health
evals.prompt: BlueBubbles ping works, but enhanced iMessage features are broken and server info shows private_api true with helper_connected false. What should you say and check next?
evals.expected_output: Explains that normal server/API health is up but the Private API helper is disconnected, uses bluebubbles server info/logs and doctor, and says repair may require SIP/boot-arg work before re-checking helper_connected true.
assertions: Distinguishes normal server health from enhanced iMessage health
Mentions bluebubbles server info or doctor
Mentions SIP or boot args as possible repair path

evals.name: Use the BlueBubbles CLI first
evals.prompt: I need to inspect recent iMessage chats and maybe send a message. What workflow should the agent use?
evals.expected_output: Uses bluebubbles CLI help/config first, lists chat/message/handle commands, starts with read/list/get operations, uses JSON for scripts, and confirms GUIDs/addresses before sending.
assertions: Mentions config sync or config set
Requires confirming GUIDs or addresses before sending

evals.name: Agent iMessage runtime host checks
evals.prompt: The agent iMessage runtime is flaky after moving machines. What local truth checks matter?
evals.expected_output: Checks whether this is the intended host/account, Messages process, BlueBubbles local status/logs, Tailscale reachability, SIP state, and preserves the separate account/home MacBook Air runtime model.
assertions: Mentions pgrep -x Messages or Messages process
Mentions bluebubbles server local status or logs
Mentions separate macOS account or home MacBook Air
